citation.authors: Lannuzel A, Ruberg M, Michel PP

cited_by.title: Soursop (graviola): cancer cure, blood sugar and safety

record.population: Patients with atypical parkinsonism on Guadeloupe; midbrain cell cultures; rats
record.design: Epidemiological association plus lab and animal experiments (review of the programme)
record.finding: On Guadeloupe atypical parkinsonian patients were two-thirds of all parkinsonism cases, against about 5% in European data. Epidemiological data suggested a close association with regular consumption of soursop. Annonacin, a mitochondrial complex I inhibitor in the fruit and leaves, was identified in cell cultures as a probable cause, and giving it to rats reproduced the brain lesions.
record.note: Review by authors of the original work. MSK notes it is unclear whether the neurotoxicity translates to humans, and one review reports a favourable profile for leaf extract.
